title: The Traditional Months
label: ch:ka-traditional-months
canDo: I can name the twelve traditional Kannada months and say when the new year Ugadi falls.

payoff.summary: Recite Caitra through Phālguṇa, place Ugadi at Chaitra Śukla Pratipada, and note that this calendar is shared with Hindi, not with Tamil or Malayalam.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: KA-C16-tingalugalu (440) assesses both of its own atoms. The other three — the anchor word ಉತ್ತರ (KA-C16-uttara, 444), ಉ (KA-S126-letter-u, 445) and ೮ (KA-S147-digit-eight, 447) — belong to the script strand and are taught after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and none of those lessons is a fitting payoff for the months.
